q.q: At what time between 6 and 7 o'clock will the hands of a clock coincide?
q.e: Coincide when 6m = 30h + 0.5m, i.e. m = 60h/11.

q.q: Statement: V = R = Q = X ≤ S < U. Conclusions: I. S ≥ Q  II. X ≤ S  III. Q < S. Which of the conclusions is/are definitely true?
o: Only I and II are true
q.e: A conclusion is definitely true only if it holds for every set of values consistent with the whole chain.

q.q: One term in the series 18, 36, 57, 90, 126, 168, 216 is wrong. Find the wrong term.
q.e: Rule: triangular numbers × 6. The term 57 should have been 60.

q.q: A man walks 12 m towards the west. He turns left. Then he walks 8 m. He turns right. Then he walks 20 m. He turns right. Then he walks 8 m. How far is he from the starting point, and in which direction (from the starting point) is he now?
q.e: Net displacement is 32 m west and 0 m south; distance = √(32² + 0²) = 32 m.
